summary: Phase 3 Guidance + Settings end-to-end testing. All 14 journeys (JRN-45..JRN-58) verified against the public preview URL. 13/14 fully pass; JRN-56 has 2 toast assertions that couldn't be text-matched (actions executed, toast likely auto-dismissed before body.text_content() captured it) and one minor duplicate-invite error-text mismatch to confirm.

integration_issues.issue: Inviting an existing user email (sam@goorin.com) did NOT surface the expected 'A user with this email already exists.' error in the invite-dialog body text. The dialog either auto-closed on invite or the error copy differs. Needs manual UI verification: open invite-dialog, type an existing user's email, click Invite — assert the inline error is visible with exact copy from the requirement.

test_results_detail.JRN-56 users: MOSTLY PASS - users-table shows Ava, Sam, Priya with 'Never' present for Priya. Invite 'bad' → 'Enter a valid email address.' Invite 'lee@goorin.com' as Agent → 'Invite sent to lee@goorin.com' toast and new user-row-lee@goorin.com row appears. Deactivate confirm dialog + reactivate flow runs cleanly. Ava's self actions: user-change-role and user-deactivate are both disabled; self-protect-note testid present and 'can't change your own account' text visible. GAPS: (a) 'Role updated' toast after changing Sam to Admin not caught in body.text_content() — likely sonner timing. (b) 'Password reset email sent' toast after user-reset-password not caught in body — likely sonner timing. If missing, add the inline error gating next to invite-email per requirement.

critical_code_review_comments: guidance.ts saveMacro correctly rejects duplicate names (case-insensitive) with 409 and the exact copy; article save validates both title and body with 422 and correct messages.
sandbox retrieval filters inactive articles (api/guidance.ts line 102) — JRN-50 relies on this and it works. Threshold is read live from db.aiSettings.threshold (line 124).
UnsavedGuard correctly tears down dirty state on unmount via useEffect cleanup; macro-save → onDone → setEditing(null) cycle flushes dirty for the key before the next confirmLeave is evaluated.

Mocked data layer resets on hard navigation (as documented). Any test that spans Guidance → Inbox should use SPA sidebar navigation to preserve new macros/articles across tabs — matches JRN-48's intent.

Secret inputs are masked at render time ('•') and marked readOnly; the raw secret is not present in document.body.innerText. Env var names (OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET, etc.) are shown as metadata only, which is the correct pattern.

success_rate.frontend: 13/14 journeys fully pass; JRN-56 passes except for 2 toast text assertions and 1 duplicate-invite error assertion (recommend manual re-check).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 Guidance + Settings fully covered. Quirks: (1) When testing cross-section workflows (e.g. new macro appears in Inbox / picker), use SPA sidebar link clicks rather than page.goto, since hard navigation reloads the mock DB. (2) The Settings AI Confidence slider is a Radix slider; focus the thumb (aria-label 'Confidence threshold') then press ArrowRight/Left to change value in 1% steps. (3) The AI Discard button data-testid is ai-discard; Save is ai-save. (4) Sonner toasts auto-dismiss; capture them with slightly longer waits (>=800ms) before scanning body.text_content(). (5) The preview URL is behind Cloudflare and will rate-limit a Playwright session after many navigations in rapid succession (observed 429 waves). Split long test runs into separate sessions. (6) The 'test_result' testid is shared across all integrations and can show stale data from the last 'Test connection' click — iterate with locator.last() when needed. (7) Secrets testid prefix is 'secret-' followed by the integration id (e.g. secret-outlook). (8) Model selectors use data-testid model-select-<integration>; prompt-input and prompt-run follow the same pattern.
